today_summary: GCM26 marked $4,440.3 with ATM IV 23.05% and a 0.34 P/C OI ratio — 175,174 of 191,027 total call OI sits above spot versus just 8,705 puts, the most one-sided call skew of the current cycle. The binding structure is a 14,604-contract call shelf at $4,500–$4,510, roughly 1.4% overhead and almost exactly one 1σ session ($64.5, 1.45%) away. Net GEX within ±$200 of spot is +274, so dealers are long gamma here and actively dampening range. Headline max pain of $6,300 sits 42% above spot and is an artifact of legacy far-OTM call OI at $5,500 and $8,000 — it carries no near-term pinning force.
five_day_thesis: Five sessions ago spot was $4,304.3 with ATM IV at 21.36%; it has since ground $136.0 higher (+3.2%) without a single meaningful down-day, and IV rose 1.69pp alongside it to 23.05%. That combination — spot up, vol up — is the week's real signal: this is call-side premium being bid, not fear being hedged, and it matches call volume running 2.8:1 over puts (4,470 vs 1,611) with the heaviest prints at the upside $4,700, $5,200 and $5,500 strikes. Simultaneously the long-gamma window total expanded 60%, from +294.29 to +470.32, so dealer stabilization deepened even as the underlying rallied — realized range compressed while implied vol expanded, which is why the tape has trended rather than lurched. Max pain finally broke a four-day freeze at $6,500 and drifted -$200 to $6,300, but at 42% above spot it remains a legacy-OI artifact rather than a magnet, and the nominal $3,500 put wall and $8,000 call wall have not moved a single strike all week. The tradeable structure is entirely in the near-spot ladder, where the $4,500 shelf has become the week's decisive ceiling.

prediction: Bias constructive above $4,400, with the path of least resistance a continued grind into the $4,500–$4,510 call shelf, where 14,604 contracts of call OI should cap the first attempt. Long dealer gamma (+274 near spot) argues for a contained 1σ $64.5 range and mean-reversion rather than trend acceleration, so fade extensions beyond $4,505 until the shelf is cleared on volume. Loss of $4,375 invalidates the constructive read and opens the $4,300 put wall (2,351 contracts).
